prerequisites: EM1012 - Mechanics of Machines and Structures
EM1019 - Elasticity and Strength of Materials
EM1020 - Theory of Machines and Mechanisms

learning_outcomes.text: Be able to organize teamwork for the design of machine components within an established deadline.
Be able to solve problems of machine element calculation considering their strength, rigidity, and durability.
Be able to write technical reports to explain and document the design and testing of machine components.
Be able to select from diverse and dispersed documentation for autonomous learning in topics related to machine design.
Be able to analyze and design machine elements from the point of view of their strength, rigidity, and durability.
Be able to identify the various elements of a machine both in a plan and in a real system.
Be able to analyze the strength and rigidity of motion transmission elements in machines.
Be able to analyze the strength of machine parts subjected to static and dynamic loads.
Be able to appropriately select rotation and translation guiding elements in machines.
Be able to plan tests of machines or their components.
Be able to classify and analyze the most common joining systems in machine elements.
Know the current regulations related to machine design.

syllabus_topics: Design in Mechanical Engineering. Design phases
Fatigue strength under alternating stresses. Fatigue limit
Torque and power transmission of pressure-fitted shafts
Maximum tensile force in a pressure fit
Load distribution in a threaded joint
Design and dimensioning of threaded joints
Design and dimensioning of riveted joints
Selection of ball and cylindrical roller bearings
Disc and Conical Brakes and Clutches
Computer-assisted Static and Dynamic Support Analysis
assessment_rules: Students pass if they obtain at least 5 out of 10 points in the overall average grade. For the first sitting, if a grade less than 3 is obtained in the final exam, the maximum overall grade for the course will be 4.5. For the second sitting, students can retake the partial exam (the higher grade will be considered) and the final exam (the higher grade will be considered); if a grade less than 3 is obtained in the final exam, the maximum overall grade will be 4.5. Lab practices are not recoverable due to logistical limitations. For the extraordinary end-of-studies sitting, the final exam accounts for 100% with no minimum grade required. Fraud in any continuous assessment activity results in a 0 for that activity; fraud in the final exam results in a 0 for that sitting, and alternative assessment methods may be imposed.
